infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Marigold uses the camera to scan food labels, menus, medication packs and product ingredients so we can give you a calm safety verdict.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Marigold uses the microphone when you ask a question out loud about something you're holding.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Marigold uses your photo library when you pick an existing photo of a label, menu or product to scan.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Marigold uses Face ID to unlock the app so your pregnancy journal stays private — even if someone else picks up your phone.
